versioningNote: backend via MinVer (git tag); frontend not versioned
ciTriggerNote: .github/workflows/release.yml (GitHub) / .gitlab-ci.yml (GitLab) trigger on the v* tag push: test, then production images versioned from the tag, then the release; PRs and pushes to dev run the same test gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml); once test / backend and test / frontend are required checks on main, a release PR can merge only after they pass (wait for them, or use gh pr merge --auto)
